title: US Congress’ COFA Delay Jeopardizes a Key Element of the ’Free and Open Indo-Pacific’
subtitle: The U.S. government concluded COFA renewal talks with Palau, Micronesia, and the Marshall Islands in 2023. Months later, Congress has yet to approve the funding.
